body.p: There was the man Ichegdyro. He tied up his mother firmly to the middle pole of the yurt. He jumped ten times off from the threshold. Jumping he said: "A year has passed! Wait in the tenth year [for me], I will come." Ichegdyro left. There the man found a trace, a big heel(?) of the size of a kumalan. He met a [DCh]: A kumalan is a seat in the Evenki tent which is covered with furs.human with two heads, an ogre. Ichegdyro said: "Grandfather, let me see your knife." The ogre give [it to him] to let him examine. Then Ichegdyro said: "Grandfather, look, there are children going! How don't you see [them]?" The ogre looked. When that one was looking for the children, Ichegdyro chopped his heads with an axe. Both heads fell down. Then the ogre said again: "Do it again, chop with the axe!" "No, once is enough." Ichegdyro chopped down two larches, he dropped them, he squashed the ogre. He went on again. There he again found [a trace], again along the trace [there are] heels of the size of a kumalan. He met an ogre with three heads. "Yesterday Ichegdyro killed your children", small birds said to the ogre. Ichegdyro came and said: "Grandfather, look, how will I kill then? What am I, look, how do I kill, I am small, grandfather, give me your knife to examine." The ogre gave [it], Ichegdyro began to examine [it], again he said: "Grandfather, look there, my children are running, how don't you see [them], look, look narrowly." The old man began to look, then Ichegdyro hit him with the axe. The old man said: "Ichegdyro, do it again, hit with the axe." Ichegdyro said: "Once is enough." He chopped down three larches, brought then, squashed him. Again he went on. Again he met a human with four heads. That one said: "[You have] a small axe! Small birds said yesterday: Ichegdyro defeats your children, kills." He started to sharpen his axe; Ichegdyro said: "Grandfather, bring you knife." That one gave [it], Ichegdyto started to examine, he said: "Do you see them there?" The ogre again started to look. Ichegdyro chopped with the axe, he chopped all heads off. The old man said: "Chop with the axe then." "No, it's enough now; we, the Ogdyro people, [can] not chop." Ichegdyro chopped down four larches, he squashed him. Again he went on, again he found traces, along the traces there are again such, soles as big as a kumalan, then he met a human with five heads. The ogre said: "Who are you? Small birds said: Ichegdi kills your children, defeats [them]." Ichegdyro said: "Grandfather, look, with what(?) do I kill, I am small." The ogre sharpened his knife. "[Let] me sharpen it", Ichegdyro said, "give it [to me] to examine!" The ogre gave his knife. That one said again: "Look, your children are going! How don't you see? Look, they [DCh]: Not clear why reflexive possessive suffix at subject of the clause.are very close." He started to look, Ichegdyro chopped with the axe these five heads. He chopped his heads off. The old man said: "Chop again with the axe." Ichegdyro said: "I don't chop, once is enough." Ichegdyro chopped down five larches, he carried them, he squashed him with the five larches. Again he left, again he met a human with six heads, again with heels and soles as big as a kumalan. He met a human, that one was with six heads (?). "Who are you? Well, exactly Ichegdyro, [who] defeats children, small birds said yesterday." Ichegdyro said: "Grandfather, look, how(?) do I defeat, I am small. Grandfather, bring your knife to examine. Grandfather, children are playing very nearby, how don't you see [them]?"[DCh]: Not clear why reflexive possessive suffix at subject of a clause. The old man started to look, Ichegdyro chopped his heads with the axe, he chopped off all; he chopped six larches, carried them, squashed him. Again Ichegdyro left, he met a human with seven heads, again he killed [= chopped] his heads. Then he met a human with eight heads, he killed [= chopped] his heads. Then he met a [human] with nine heads, again he killed. He met a [human] with ten heads, he killed [him] too, he chopped down ten larches, he chopped, he carried them, he squashed him. He came back to his mother. He came back, his mother had lain down near the fire. Ichegdyro kicked his mother, he(?) tore out her lungs. His mother died.
